stdout: (no config - demo: four invented magnet ideas, and the results of three live ones)
IDEAS - scored on AAJ's rules, ranked by score per ten build hours

Board marketing slide template (template, gated): 8/10, 12 h to build, 6.7 per 10 h [ranked] - specific problem +2, appeals only to your buyer +2, answer in <=30 min +1, reusable +2, leads somewhere +1

Churn & NRR calculator (tool): 10/10, 30 h to build, 3.3 per 10 h [ranked] - specific problem +2, appeals only to your buyer +2, answer in <=10 min +2, reusable +2, inputs reveal fit +1, leads somewhere +1

Marketing maturity assessment (assessment, gated): 8/10, 120 h to build, 0.7 per 10 h [ranked] - specific problem +2, appeals only to your buyer +2, answer in <=10 min +2, inputs reveal fit +1, leads somewhere +1
- A one-off: once read, never returned to. Fine, but it earns no second visit.
- 120 hours to build. Above 80 (this engine's rule) ship a smaller version first and see whether anyone uses it.
The Ultimate Guide to SaaS Marketing (guide, gated): 0/10, 25 h to build, 0.0 per 10 h [fix]
! No buyer problem stated. A magnet that is "about" a topic collects readers, not buyers.
- It appeals beyond the buyer you want, so the list it builds will need qualifying and most of it will never buy.
- 45 minutes to a useful answer. Above 30 most people stop before they get it.
- A one-off: once read, never returned to. Fine, but it earns no second visit.
- No next step. Say what the person is offered once they have their answer.
! A guide is ideas, and ideas should travel. Gate tools and templates; publish the thinking so it can be forwarded.
Build first: Board marketing slide template
RESULTS - on qualified leads, not downloads (target 60 per qualified lead)
Churn & NRR calculator: 1,400 visitors -> 610 starts (44%) -> 480 completions (79%) -> 130 emails (9% of visitors) -> 61 qualified (47%) -> 7 meetings; 39 per qualified lead
KEEP: 47% of emails fit your buyer at 39 per qualified lead. Keep it, and point more of the same traffic at it.
The Ultimate Guide to SaaS Marketing: 3,900 visitors -> 700 starts (18%) -> 700 completions (100%) -> 700 emails (18% of visitors) -> 90 qualified (13%) -> 2 meetings; 34 per qualified lead
FIX-FIT: Qualified leads are cheap (34 each) but only 13% of the list fits your buyer. Segment the list before you email it, and re-aim the promise so the other 87% stop signing up.
Board marketing slide template: 260 visitors -> 40 starts (15%) -> 15 completions (38%) -> 15 emails (6% of visitors) -> 12 qualified (80%); 33 per qualified lead
- 38% of starters finish. Below 50% (this engine's rule) the flow is the problem: too many inputs, or the email asked too early.
TOO-EARLY: 15 emails so far. Below 20 this engine does not judge; send more of the right traffic and read again.
